annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Regulatory simplification – The use of digital tools in better law-making (Exploratory opinion requested by the Danish Presidency)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Regulatory simplification – The use of digital tools in better law-making (Exploratory opinion requested by the Danish Presidency)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion requested by the Danish Presidency on using AI and digital tools in EU law-making. It recommends a unified interoperable legislative platform, summaries of obligations for each act, AI-based consistency checks and ex-post analysis, and a regtech chief, while keeping a human-centred approach and stakeholder dialogue.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish a unified, interoperable digital platform for EU law-making via an updated interinstitutional agreement
Attach human-translated summaries of obligations, structured as XML metadata, to each legal act
Create a centralised database of legal obligations and nominate an EU regtech chief
Use tested AI to map legal interdependencies, analyse stakeholder input and perform ex-post analysis
AI must not replace social dialogue; test for bias and discrimination
